summary: runToggleEvidence() currently destroys any pre-existing owned diagnostics overlay before recording its `initiallyEnabled` evidence field, so a successful sweep can erase a dirty entry condition and then report `initiallyEnabled=false`. This is distinct from the already-owned post-enable failure-cleanup defect and should be absorbed into the active generation-17 diagnostics successor rather than spawning another primary.
evidence: Current main at eead13b2e90ffbba36248909d97e17856e002ad9 has runToggleEvidence() call PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.disable(lab), then Validation.captureFull(lab.model), then PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.capture(lab); the returned evidence later binds initiallyEnabled = initial.enabled. Any successful entry therefore records only the normalized post-disable state.

Retained generation-16 diagnostics PR #441 exact head b8ca3302cc3012011fb911ad3df5dc878130c133 preserves the same disable-before-initial-capture ordering while adding enabled-window canonical validation, so the seam remains in the current successor lineage.

tests/physics_lab_diagnostics_final_state.luau protects the final disabled publication path but does not protect pre-cleanup entry-state provenance; tests/physics_lab_diagnostics_bounds.luau covers cycle bounds only.

Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_DIAGNOSTICS.md requires separate engine evidence that diagnostics are off by default after normal bootstrap/rebuild. A helper that silently cleans before observing entry state cannot itself substantiate that starting-state fact and its currently published initiallyEnabled field is misleading if callers treat it as entry provenance.

The active HG-BACKFILL-DIAGNOSTICS primary generation-17 claim belongs to sol-20260814-t5n8q3v6 on branch agent/diagnostics/HG-BACKFILL-DIAGNOSTICS-primary-t5n8q3v6-g17 and already owns runToggleEvidence() cleanup hardening, making absorption preferable to a duplicate one-shot lane.
No Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, performance-device, or two-client execution was run or claimed; this is a source/evidence-contract finding only.
